items.label: Forgent Power Solutions Q4 FY2026 (09-15-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Across fiscal 2025 and 2026 the company invested approximately $190 million

set.signal: Across fiscal 2025 and 2026 the company invested approximately $190 million to bring more than 1.8 million sq ft of new manufacturing capacity online, expanding in each of its five campuses and taking the footprint from roughly 480,000 sq ft to 2.3 million sq ft (roughly a five-fold increase); construction is complete or nearing completion and plants are progressing toward target production rates. Manufacturing headcount nearly doubled; CEO: the employee base was 'roughly 1,800-ish people' at the end of 2025 and finished 2026 'right around 3,500 and 3,600'. CEO: 'we are inside the expected lead times for every product line that we have in the industry'; on supply chain, 'there isn't anything habitual that says this part went from 50 weeks out to 100 weeks.'
set.figure: manufacturing footprint 480,000 sq ft to 2.3 million sq ft (~$190 million invested); employee base ~1,800 to ~3,500-3,600; lead times inside market expectations

items.reason: The 1,800 -> 3,500/3,600 figures are the CEO's total employee base, not manufacturing headcount (he separately said manufacturing headcount nearly doubled).
items.evidence: If you take a look at the employee base, at the end of 2025, it was probably roughly 1,800-ish people. We finished 2026 right around 3,500 and 3,600.

items.label: Fervo Energy Q2 FY2026 (08-12-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Pipeline: eight GeoBlocks representing 400 megawatts moved from early

set.signal: Pipeline: eight GeoBlocks representing 400 megawatts moved from early into advanced development (interconnection queue applications submitted, geological surveys completed, appraisal-well permits secured); 10.5 gigawatts across two geoclusters moved from land holdings into early development after DeGolyer and MacNaughton heat-in-place studies; geothermal mineral rights expanded to over 650,000 acres. Cape Station: 500 megawatts under construction of over 4 GW of total resource potential. Appraisal plans across the geocluster portfolio begin in Q4; CEO: 'ramping up an appraisal program for some of our Nevada prospects and beyond.'

items.reason: The call does not say the appraisal program is 'mainly' Nevada; the CEO said 'some of our Nevada prospects and beyond'.
items.evidence: So we're really excited to be ramping up an appraisal program for some of our Nevada prospects and beyond.

items.label: Amtech Systems Q3 FY2026 (08-05-2026)
items.signal_prefix: New products: to accelerate growth beyond 2027, Amtech is developing

set.signal: New products: to accelerate growth beyond 2027, Amtech is developing new equipment platforms and process capabilities for emerging semiconductor applications and higher-density packaging, and plans to introduce some of them at the SEMICON Taiwan trade show in early September. CEO on lead times for the new platforms versus its typical six to eight weeks: 'I suspect we'll be on the high end, maybe a little bit north of that'; 'It may take six, nine months before the cycle times get to that point.'

items.reason: CEO said the high end of, maybe a little north of, six to eight weeks, not 'at or slightly above'; the six-to-nine-month normalization was omitted.
items.evidence: Right now, this is similar to the platforms we're producing with typical lead times of six to eight weeks. I suspect we'll be on the high end, maybe a little bit north of that

items.label: Gates Industrial Q2 FY2026 (07-31-2026)
items.signal_prefix: CFO Brooks Mallard on price and cost: Gates implemented price increases

set.signal: CFO Brooks Mallard on price and cost: Gates implemented price increases to offset oil- and petroleum-related material cost increases (costs stable or slightly rising, no relief expected) and expects to be at least price-cost neutral in the second half; Q3 incremental margins are expected at 35%-40%, moving back to 45%+ in Q4. Footprint and cost optimization benefits are expected to roll through to the end of 2027. CEO, asked whether the 24.5% adjusted EBITDA margin target from the 2024 Capital Markets Day is feasible in 2027: 'That's definitely how we are thinking about that'; 24.5% is not 'some magic endpoint', and an update will come with the next CMD, likely in 2027.

items.reason: The CEO's quote was garbled ('is how we are thinking about it'); he was answering whether the 24.5% target is feasible in 2027.
items.evidence: Thanks for the question, Jerry. That's definitely how we are thinking about that. ... we don't believe that 24.5% is some magic endpoint and we will provide update as we start to think about the next CMD, likely in 2027.
